    Proposition 12.2 in its general form #

    deformation-refinements.tex (prop:characteristic-two-normal-form): "Let C = kQ/(r_v : v ∈ V) be a finite-dimensional graded algebra over any field, with Q finite and the r_v homogeneous quadratic relations. For each q ≥ 3, choose homogeneous path tuples p_i of degree d_i = q whose classes form a basis of coker D_{q-1}. […] Every algebra E with a finite filtration and a specified identification gr E = C has a presentation E ≅ kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_i λ_i (p_i)_v) for some scalars λ_i. The isomorphism induces the specified identification on the associated grading."

    In the setting of the general Proposition 5.4 (NormalFormGeneral.lean: E a finite filtered k-linear category on the vertices with symbols realizing gr E = C), with retained tuples p_j of degrees ≥ 3 whose classes together with im D_{q-1} span (the basis hypothesis is stronger), there are scalars λ and arrow lifts satisfying r_v = Σ λ_j (p_j)_v exactly (exists_retained); the realization kQ → E is onto every Hom space, its kernel is the ideal generated by r_v − Σ λ_j (p_j)_v and the paths of length > N for any N with F^N = 0, and it induces the identification on the associated grading (normalFormRetained). The proof is the source's: in increasing degree q, split the degree-q errors as D_{q-1}(f) + Σ c_j [p_j], retain the c_j and change the arrows by lifts of f; a retained word of degree d_j ≥ 3 changes only in degree ≥ q + d_j − 2 > q, and the two-correction terms have degree 2q − 2.

          Proposition 12.2 (prop:characteristic-two-normal-form), general form: for quadratic relations r_v, retained tuples p_j of degrees ≥ 3 whose classes together with im D_{q-1} span the degree-q relation families (q ≥ 3; a basis of the cokernel in the source), and any finite filtered category E on the vertices with gr E = C, there are scalars λ and arrow lifts satisfying r_v = Σ λ_j (p_j)_v; the realization kQ → E is onto every Hom space, its kernel is the ideal (𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ λ_j (p_j)_v) for every N with F^N = 0, so E ≅ kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ λ_j (p_j)_v) (full and faithful Φ), and it induces the given identification gr E = C.
